24.verdict: level with the channel's earlier Shorts at this age: 823 views against a median of 741 (1.1x)

worked: A strong pacing velocity of 33.5 views per hour and 823 views outperformed the historical median (~24 views per hour) due to an immediate high-stakes opening line.
Generated 3 comments, the highest in the cohort where 8 out of 10 prior shorts had 0, showing that the visceral ending line sparked discussion.
hurt: Views per hour capped at 33.5 compared to the channel's top cohort pace of 47.6 views per hour, diluted by the abstract hook text '3.8 BILLION LIGHT-YEARS AWAY' rather than immediate jeopardy.
Repetitive narrative beats (revealing the jet pointed at Earth in beat 1, then restating it in beat 6) weakened mid-script tension, keeping likes per 100 at a modest 4.0.
diagnosis.change_next: Change the visual hook text to lead with the immediate threat rather than distance (e.g., 'AIMED DIRECTLY AT EARTH' instead of '3.8 BILLION LIGHT-YEARS AWAY'), and hold the jet revelation until beat 5 so the mystery builds through the stellar shredding sequence without spoiling the climax in beat 1.

worked: High algorithmic pick-up and feed distribution achieved a 0.965 feed_share and generated 1,032 views at 14.2 views_per_hour, landing in the channel's top volume tier.
Viewer conversion stayed healthy with an engaged_share of 0.533, surpassing the cohort median of roughly 0.50.
hurt: Initial hold underperformed with watching_at_5 at 1.251 (channel top performers exceed 1.50–2.24), softened by passive, abstract hook text ('3.8 BILLION LIGHT-YEARS AWAY').

Mid-script retention dropped sharply to 0.534 watching_at_50 and dragged avg_viewed to 62.75% (the lowest in the set) because beats 2 and 3 abruptly stalled forward momentum to recount satellite detections and background lore after beat 1 had already given away the climax.

End-of-video retention fell to 0.337 watching_at_end with zero rewatch velocity (top peers reached 1.22–1.32), caused by an ending line that merely restated the opening hook instead of providing a looping transition or an unresolved escalation.
diagnosis.change_next: Do not spoil the climax in beat 1 and backtrack; start the hook with immediate stakes like 'Earth is currently in the crosshairs of a cosmic death beam,' keep the satellite detection cut, and end beat 8 with a sentence that grammatically loops back into beat 1 to lift watching_at_end above 1.0.
